sections.label: Nose
Throat
sections.text:
Relaxed, aphthous condition of mouth
and throat. Excessive secretion of saliva. Burns, feels
full. Constant sensation of phlegm in throat Enlarged,
ulcerated tonsils and inflamed throat. (Use tincture
locally.)

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Sloiv digestion. Much fetid gas. Beating
and goneness with pulsation in epigastric arteries.
Spleen hard and contracted.

sections.label: Abdomen
sections.text:
Acute diarrhoea. Aching pains in bowels
with feeling of impending diarrhoea. Dysentery, with
rectal heat ; tenesmus ; luemorrhage. Diarrhoea ; stools
thin, watery, preceded by sharp pains. Typhoid diar-
rha'a.

sections.label: Urinary
sections.text:
Acute nephritis complicating influenza.
Hsematuria. Suppurative inflammation of kidneys.
Urine contains pus and is deficient in urea. Bladder
feels loss of expulsive force. Burning and tenesmus;
catarrh of bladder; diuresis ; urethral caruncle.

sections.label: Respiratory

Asthma, with great dyspneea and pal-
pitation. Moist asthma. Expectoration white, thick
mucus. Bronchitis in the aged, Bronchorrhoea. \Bals.

Irritative cough. Whooping-cough in rachitic children.
Fetid form of bronchitis, bronchial dilatation and em-
physema.

sections.text:
Glandular enlargements and nodular swell-
ing over joints. Foul and indolent ulcers. Herpetic

sections.label: Fever
sections.text:
Elevation of temperature. Continued and
typhoid fevers. Scarlet fever (protective and curative.)
Discharges show a tendency to foulness, high tempera-
ture, accelerated hut not strong pulse. Use the tincture.
